title: Tech Note: Using Expressions in 4D Styled Text
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: ST INSERT EXPRESSION / ST SET OPTIONS / ST COMPUTE EXPRESSIONS / ST FREEZE EXPRESSIONS
ST GET PLAIN TEXT / ST GET TEXT

historical_commentary.text: Embedding live 4D expressions into styled-text variables for mail-merge-style letters, emails, and templates was a genuinely useful capability for its time, and the classic ST_ command family it relies on still exists and functions in current 4D versions. However, for serious document generation and mail-merge scenarios 4D has since introduced 4D Write Pro, a far more capable rich-document engine with its own reference/formula mechanism, making this styled-text-variable approach a lighter-weight but now secondary technique rather than the primary recommended path for rich document generation.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro (introduced 4D v16) provides a full word-processing engine with references and formulas, now the recommended approach for rich document/email generation
4D Write Pro documents use an open, text-friendly format better suited to Project Mode workflows
